title: Sue-Per Saver
description: A paid message from Sue-Per Saver. Justice at warehouse prices.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-chipper
lines.text: Been wronged? <p:0.2> Sue-Per Saver sues anyone for nineteen dollars! <p:0.2> No case too weak, no target too random. <p:0.2> We'll sue the sky if you point at it. <p:0.2> Sue-Per Saver, litigate everything!

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: Your lawyer is a parrot in a tie. <p:0> You may be countersued by us. <p:0> Winnings paid in expired coupons. <p:0> Terms and conditions apply.
